title: Dynamic Capital Ledger
x_note: The Aegis sub-fund capital anchor (MED-1). The single most load-bearing money handoff — validated on write. dynCap = allocation + realised + UNREALISED = current Aegis equity, mark-to-market (D-41, revises D-21).

allocated_capital_usd.description: from config/aegis_fund.md; null = unset -> sizing refuses

realised_pnl_usd.description: realised P&L on closed AEGIS trades

unrealised_pnl_usd.description: D-41: marked unrealised P&L on open AEGIS positions (from the PTJ)

dyncap_usd.description: allocation + realised + unrealised (current Aegis equity); null when allocation unset

open_count.description: D-41: open AEGIS positions marked into dynCap

marked_asof.description: D-41: PTJ mark timestamp; dynCap is mark-to-market so this must be fresh (refreshed each premarket)
